map.当量浓度 = 物质的量 × 当量数 / 体积，常用于酸碱氧化还原滴定。: Normality = amount of substance × equivalence factor / volume, commonly used in acid-base and redox titrations.
map.📖 查看「当量浓度（N = n·z / V） 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Normality (N = n·z / V) Usage Guide"
map.N = n·z / V；z 为每摩尔的当量数。 1 mol H₂SO₄(z=2): N = n·z / V; z is the number of equivalents per mole. 1 mol H₂SO₄ (z = 2) made up to 1 L gives 2 N.
map.N = n·z / V；z 为每摩尔的当量数。: N = n·z / V; z is the number of equivalents per mole.
map.1 mol H₂SO₄(z=2) 配 1 L 得 2 N。: 1 mol H₂SO₄ (z = 2) made up to 1 L gives 2 N.
map.酸碱滴定：一元酸 z=1、二元酸 z=2，N=c·z。: Acid-base titration: z = 1 for monoprotic acids and z = 2 for diprotic acids, so N = c·z.
map.氧化还原：由电子转移数定 z，算当量浓度。: Redox: set z from the electron transfer number, then compute the normality.
map.当量换算：N 与 c 经 z 桥接，统一计量。: Equivalent conversion: N and c are bridged by z, unifying the measurement basis.
map.输入 c=0.1 mol/L、z=2，工具输出 N=0.2 N，并提示 z 随反: Enter c = 0.1 mol/L and z = 2, the tool outputs N = 0.2 N and notes that z changes with the reaction type.
map.z（当量数）怎么定？: How is z (the equivalence factor) determined?
map.酸碱看可交换 H⁺/OH⁻ 数；氧化还原看电子转移数。: For acids and bases, count the exchangeable H⁺/OH⁻; for redox, use the electron transfer number.
map.滴定仍用，尤其氧化还原；现代多直接用 mol/L+z。: Still used in titrations, especially redox; modern practice often uses mol/L plus z directly.
map.N 和 c 能直接比吗？: Can N and c be compared directly?
map.N=z·c，z 不同数值不同，需注明反应类型。: N = z·c, so different z gives different numbers; always state the reaction type.
